meta.name: kamus-draft-jawa
meta.description: Kamus Jawa clean dengan sinonim per field. Entries di-MERGE by ngoko (synonym groups). krama_inggil di-merge ke krama.
meta.format: id, ngoko, krama (comma-separated sinonim per field)
meta.source: Supabase kamus_draft (Lengkap entries, merged by ngoko)
meta.merge_strategy: Group by ngoko (case-insensitive). Union all indonesian + id_synonyms → id. Union all ngoko + dasanama → ngoko. Union all krama + krama_inggil → krama.
